Broad and Reliable Coverage Across Japan with Nomad’s eSIM

Explore Japan with confidence using Nomad's Japan eSIM, offering reliable 4G/5G coverage from major cities like Tokyo, Osaka, Kyoto to remote scenic spots. Stay connected no matter where your adventure takes you.

How to Install and Activate / Start eSIM ?

You can buy and install the eSIM now, but activate or start it only when you need it. Just make sure to activate your plan within 60 days of the purchase date. After that, it will automatically activate and start the expiry.

01

Install your eSIM

Scan the QR code that is provided to install your eSIM. You will need internet connection to install your eSIM. The eSIM is now added to your phone.

02

Start your eSIM

Your plan will start automatically once connected to the destination network (as detailed in Step 3).

03

Connect at destination

STEP 1.Go to Settings > Cellular and turn this line on.

STEP 2.Make sure "Data Roaming" is toggled on and you are selecting the Nomad eSIM for "Cellular Data".

STEP 3.The eSIM will automatically find and connect to the best local network for you.

Nomad Japan eSIM FAQ

01

What is eSIM?

eSIM stands for embedded SIM and allows you to get connected anywhere, anytime. It works like a traditional SIM card, except without a need for the physical card. As long as your device is compatible, you will be able to use an eSIM.

02

How to install eSIM?

The recommended way to install your eSIM is through the QR code we provided via in-app instruction and email.
a. On iOS: Go to Settings > Cellular (or Mobile Data) > Add Cellular Plan (or Add Data Plan), then scan the QR code
b. On Android (Google Pixel): Go to Settings > Network and Internet > SIMs > Add More> Download a SIM instead, and then scan the QR code
c. On Android (Samsung): Go to Settings > Connections > SIM Card Manager > Add Mobile Plan > Scan QR code

For more information refer to this blog post.
Remember to turn “Data Roaming” on to start using your data!

03

Is my device compatible with Nomad’s Japan eSIM?

Refer to this for a list of e-SIM compatible devices.

04

Can I keep my primary SIM while using Nomad’s eSIM?

Yes, you can. You can keep your primary SIM card in your phone while using Nomad's eSIM for your data. Make sure to update your phone settings to use Nomad's eSIM for data to avoid incurring roaming costs.

05

What if I run out of data?

You will get a notification when your data is running low OR when your plan is about to expire.
Some of our plans have add-ons available. If you run out of data, simply purchase an add-on plan from our shop to top up your data volume. The additional data will be tied to the main eSIM.

06

Is hotspot and tethering supported?

Yes, Nomad’s eSIMs support tethering / hotspot.

07

Does the Japan eSIM Include a Local Phone Number?

Some of Nomad's eSIMs include a local phone number. Check the plan details for more information of what your plan includes.

08

How much data do I need while travelling in Japan?

The amount of data you need depends on your data usage behaviour. If you are not sure how much data you need, you can use Nomad’sData Calculatorto find a plan that is suitable for you.

09

How does using an eSIM compare to Pocket WiFi?

An eSIM is more convenient when traveling as you can stay connected without having to carry another device around.

10

Are there long-term plans available for Japan?

Nomad offers long-termGlobal-EXplans suitable for frequent flyers, which includes up to year-long coverage in over 54 / 82 destinations worldwide.

11

What is the best eSIM for Japan?

The best eSIM for Japan depends on your travel needs, including coverage, data allowance, trip length and price. Nomad is a popular choice for travellers thanks to its reliable connectivity, instant activation and flexible prepaid plans, making it easy to stay connected throughout your trip.

12

Why choose Nomad eSIM for your trip to Japan?

Nomad eSIM combines reliable network coverage, quick digital activation and a range of prepaid data plans to suit different travel needs. Whether you're visiting for a short holiday or a longer stay, Nomad makes it easy to get online without the hassle of buying a physical SIM card.

13

Is Nomad a good eSIM for Japan?

Yes. Nomad eSIM is a convenient choice for travellers visiting Japan, offering reliable coverage, instant activation and flexible prepaid data plans. Simply purchase your plan online, install your eSIM before you travel and connect when you arrive, without needing to swap a physical SIM card.

14

Will Nomad eSIM work throughout Japan?

Nomad eSIM connects to trusted local network partners to provide reliable coverage across much of Japan. Coverage may vary depending on your location and network availability, particularly in remote areas or overseas territories.
